text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
New members were steadily joining the team.
Then, one day—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "I have just received a divine revelation from Lady Shiraoki~!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Praying for the peace and prosperity of our team!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To put it bluntly!
I believe we should hang calligraphy reading "Soul in Every Lap" in the clubroom!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Leaving behind those parting words, Matikane Fukukitaru hurriedly left the Trainer's Office.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply! I shall bestow upon you a team name!
Yes, and that name is—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Harenohi Runners"!
Please, by all means, make that our team name!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should consider
the team name they suggested!
